description: This file is a PHP class definition for the 'Coupon' extension model in the OpenCart e-commerce platform. It contains methods for calculating and managing coupon discounts within the order total calculation process, including applying, confirming, and unconfirming coupons.

classes.name: Coupon
classes.description: Represents the coupon total extension model, responsible for calculating and applying coupon discounts during the cart total calculation process.

methods.name: getTotal
methods.description: Calculates the total discount based on the coupon code, adjusting the totals, taxes, and overall order total accordingly.

methods.name: confirm
methods.description: Confirms the application of a coupon to an order, updating coupon usage histories and validity.

methods.name: unconfirm
methods.description: Removes the coupon confirmation from an order, deleting related coupon usage history.
